entities.name: Caradog ap Gruffudd
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Caradog ap Gruffudd was a Prince of Gwent in south-east Wales in the time of Gruffudd ap Llywelyn and the Norman conquest, who reunified his family's inheritance of Morgannwg and made repeated attempts to reunite southern Wales by claiming the inheritance of the kingdom of Deheubarth.
